parsed.explanation: Transgender visitors face moderate societal risk, escalating significantly if visibly outed outside the capital. While civic space accommodates annual Pride marches and community drop-in centres, public attitudes exhibit deep-seated stigma. Ground-level reports confirm that visibly trans individuals routinely face discrimination, harassment, and frequent physical and sexual harassment in public spaces and institutions, particularly in provincial and rural areas. Severe gender-based violence is documented domestically, alongside family-driven conversion practices such as forced exorcisms. Furthermore, anti-LGBTQ sentiments are reportedly gaining momentum, manifesting in public protest rallies and widespread online hate speech and death threats by political supporters, creating a hostile social environment despite some urban visibility.
